implementation.targetScope: Stylis4 middleware for RootThemeProvider LTR/RTL styling, nesting, annotations, layers and prefixing. Changes declaration nodes in place; does not depend on or reparse through a second Stylis runtime.

changes: Keeps AST identity and source positions; no serialize/compile round trip.
Transforms nested rules even when app middleware wraps their parent in @layer.
Binds noflip by source order, including lifted nested rules; repeated serialization cannot flip twice.
Uses vcssjanus for directional semantics; retains no DOM or source CSS cache.
